tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

No decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, no format should be treated as the project's standard.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded, and that no format should be treated as the project's standard until one is.

Muninn's catalogue has no decision on wire format. `muninn why` returned two conflicting one-line episodes, "msgpack" and "cbor". Each was a bare, unconfirmed user remark at trust 1, and `muninn why` reported the records as insufficient, so I didn't treat either as a decision. I named neither in the file.
